NAME: 3DES
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: 64 bit block birthday issues; meet in the middle; legacy and slow.

NAME: DES
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: 56 bit key brute forced in practice; completely broken.

NAME: Blowfish
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: 64 bit block birthday issues; some weak key classes; no full practical break.

NAME: IDEA
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: 64 bit block; some weak keys and related key style attacks; still unbroken in practice.

NAME: Magma (GOST 28147-89)
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Known S-box-specific attacks; depends heavily on S-box selection

NAME: CAST-128
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Reduced round and related key attacks; 64 bit block limits large volume security.

NAME: Skipjack
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: 80 bit key and 64 bit block; structural weaknesses and slide style attacks; deprecated.

NAME: PRESENT
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: 64 bit block; reduced round differential attacks; limited margin for very large data.

NAME: CLEFIA
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Reduced round and related key attacks; full rounds still secure in practice.

NAME: XTEA
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Related key and chosen plaintext attacks; security margin lower than modern designs.

NAME: KATAN
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Some reduced-round cryptanalysis; small block variants give limited security margin.

NAME: SPECK
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Active reduced round cryptanalysis; no practical attacks on full recommended variants.

NAME: HIGHT
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Reduced round attacks; 64 bit block; designed for about 80 bit security.

NAME: SIMON
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Many reduced round attacks; parameters chosen with modest margin; no full practical break.

NAME: PRINCE
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Intentionally small margin; near full round attacks and biclique techniques; still impractical.

NAME: AES
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Only reduced round and side channel attacks; no practical break on full rounds.

NAME: Twofish
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Only reduced round cryptanalysis; no practical attacks on full cipher.

NAME: Serpent
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Only reduced round attacks; very large security margin; no practical break.

NAME: Camellia
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Reduced round and related key results; full cipher considered secure.

NAME: Kuznyechik
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: No practical attacks (strong design); some S-box structural studies

NAME: SEED
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Only reduced round attacks; full cipher considered secure.

NAME: LEA
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Related key and reduced round attacks; full round parameters considered secure.

NAME: Anubis
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Only reduced round cryptanalysis; no practical attacks on full cipher.

NAME: RC6
Common vulnerabilities / attacks: Reduced round cryptanalysis; full AES finalist has no practical break.

NAME: NOEKEON

NAME: SHACAL-2

NAME: LOKI97

NAME: QARMA
